messages.en: Aina's going to that exhibition tomorrow. I want to go with her too.
Oh, have you two agreed on where to meet?
If we're going to finish all this today, we need to pull together.
Exactly. I've already asked the others to come. We can just split up the tasks when they get here.

senses.en_definition: To be or get ready to do something or for something to happen.
To be willing to do or accept something.

collocations.en: be open to advice or criticism

messages.en: Are you ready for your presentation tomorrow? If you want to do a practice run first, I can listen.
Not yet. I still need to tidy up the last bit. Are you free after lunch?
I am. Shall we give it a go at two?
The cat's just hiding under the bed. Don't worry.
Oh, no wonder I couldn't find it! I already checked the kitchen earlier.
